en: A black and white photograph showing a broad, elegant street lined with ornate, historic buildings in a European architectural style. There are several people walking along the wide sidewalks and a few bare trees, indicating a season without foliage. The lower right contains printed text, and there is handwritten text in purple ink near the top center. The image has the appearance of an early-20th-century European city.
